headline: Parliament adopts thanksgiving motion on PM's Malaysia-China tour
summary: The National Parliament unanimously passed a motion thanking Prime Minister Tarique Rahman for the 'unprecedented success' of his recent visits to Malaysia and China.
details: The National Parliament on Saturday unanimously passed a thanksgiving motion via voice vote, describing Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's visits to Malaysia and China as an 'unprecedented success'.
The motion was moved by Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives Minister Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir during the 16th working day of the budget session.
Minister Alamgir highlighted that the Prime Minister represented Bangladesh after nearly 18 years of 'fascist' rule, visiting both nations within four months of forming the government.
He stated that the visits have significantly strengthened bilateral relations and led to the signing of multiple agreements with both Malaysia and China based on mutual respect.
The motion also praised the Prime Minister for breaking traditional culture by avoiding lavish receptions during his travel and return, setting a positive example for political culture.
caption:
Unanimous support in Parliament! The National Parliament has officially thanked the Prime Minister for his 'unprecedented' visits to Malaysia and China.

The National Parliament on Saturday unanimously passed a thanksgiving motion via voice vote, describing Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's visits to Malaysia and China as an 'unprecedented success'.

The motion was moved by Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives Minister Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir during the 16th working day of the budget session.

Minister Alamgir highlighted that the Prime Minister represented Bangladesh after nearly 18 years of 'fascist' rule, visiting both nations within four months of forming the government.

He stated that the visits have significantly strengthened bilateral relations and led to the signing of multiple agreements with both Malaysia and China based on mutual respect.

The motion also praised the Prime Minister for breaking traditional culture by avoiding lavish receptions during his travel and return, setting a positive example for political culture.

#Bangladesh #NationalParliament #Diplomacy #Malaysia #China #TariqueRahman

Source: Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, Somoy News, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star
